page.layout: One column of running text, set in italic with roman passages. Two marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines where they stand. Running head at the top right, printed page number at the top left.

l.i: disciplinam: ita ἀθεόλογον[?] est, Theologiam vocare
sapientiam, vel prudentiam. Sicut autem philosophia
recte dicitur farrago scientiarum & prudentiarum:
ita Theologia est farrago sapientiarum & pruden-
tiarum religiosarum. Adhæc sicut aliæ philosophiæ
partes methodo synthetica, aliæ analytica disponun-
tur: ita Theologiæ partes theoreticæ methodo synthe-

main_text.l: tica, practicæ analytica disponi debent. Confer Trel-
cat.l.1. Inst.Theol. ab initio. Inst. Si Theologia
est habitus mixtus, cur toties vocatur sapientia? Resp.

l.i: I. Sic vocatur à fine ultimo, qui est contemplatio Dei,
ut semper - Patrus. Inista enim contemplatione situm
est summum hominis bonum, ut recte tradunt Tho-
mistæ contra Scotistas. Si ergo ultimum hunc Theo-
logiæ finem spectes, non inepte dixeris sapientiam. Hic
enim finis consistit in θεωρίᾳ[?]. II. Theologiam dici-
mus sapientiam: 1. Scripturæ exemplo, 1.Cor.2.
v.6. & Colossi.1.v.9. & 2.v.3. 2. Rei præstan-
tia, utpote quæ certissimum principiorum index est, &
amplissima omnium scientiarum princeps. 3. Co-
gnoscendi modo singulari: Distinguitur enim
hæc sapientia ab ea, quæ terrena & animalis in
Scriptura non semel appellatur. III. Quia sex sapientiæ
attributa, quæ supra recitavimus ex Arist.1.Me-
taph.c.2. competunt in Theologiam, alio tamen mo-
do, quam in Metaphysicam. Quid enim? Annon Theo-
logia docet omnia? Omnia, inquam, quæ ad salutem
sunt necessaria. Annon docet difficilia? Modum nempe
ad salutem perveniendi. Annon ea ipsa in accurata
demonstrandi ratione occupatur? Habet enim prin-
cipia certissima, & omni exceptione majora. Praeter-
ea annon maximam ad docendum habet aptitudi-

page.notes: Printed text is in italic throughout; "Trel-cat", "Inst.", "Theol." and "Resp." are set roman. The Greek word ἀθεόλογον, and θεωρίᾳ, are uncertain. "Inista" may be "In ista" (small gap). "Praeter-ea" line break is uncertain. Words after "aptitudi-" are on the final line as "nem?", which is treated as a catchword-like completion. Two marginal notes stand left: the first beside the lines "methodo synthetica", the second beside "Trel-cat.l.1. Inst.Theol." (the second note text: "Theologia an & cur sapientia absolute dicatur?"), which is not recorded in the main text above and should be added beside that line.
